title: 第49章 “新旧”之争
content_zh:
第49章 “新旧”之争-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

存书签
下一章
十一届三中全会召开前，先开了长达三十六天的中央工作会议。
这些天里，就连困在鸡零狗碎里的大杂院居民，张口是“政策”，闭口是“小道消息”。大冷的天也不在屋里吃饭，而是聚在大杂院里聊各自知道的消息。
整个菊儿胡同达到了前所未有的和谐，所谓的邻里矛盾全没了，王爱梅同志的工作量大减。
毕竟国家大事、分歧都能坐下来谈，何况大杂院里的鸡毛蒜皮，有啥是谈解决不了的？
刘振国同志不敢轻易出手买房，就怕政策出现变化。万一出现变化，挣的钱最后估计都要打水漂。
医学科学院内，学生天天三五成群的凑到一起，讨论国家大事，恨不得将自己手里的粉笔，当成指挥棒。
尤其是文学社的学生最过积极，文化人嘛，谈时政的兴趣就跟基因里带来的一样。
由于刘济民在燕京高校文学圈的地位，周围喜欢文学的大学生都愿意跑到医学科学院交流。还有不少人跑到刘济民的宿舍，想跟他探讨一下政策走向。
王硕没事儿了就往医学科学院跑，还顺带告诉刘济民一些小道消息。比如某某作家跑到《解放军文艺》要求压下刘济民的《壮志凌云》，又或者要求删掉男女感情的片段。
王硕气呼呼地告诉刘济民，真应该把这群老顽固扫进垃圾堆里，把文学这片天地让给年轻人。
“你写的那爱情诗歌也被人骂了，丫就差说是色情诗歌了。”王硕搂着刘济民的肩膀，安慰道：“
放心，编辑部有了刘老爷子的支持，现在还是能顶得住火力的。其实啊，这时候不仅是文学争论了，毕竟开着大会呢，会场上才热闹呢！”
“济民同志，我就瞅你对脾气，现在军队的青年作家，你算一个，我嘛，也算一个，只不过我潜龙在渊，名声不显，只发了一篇诗歌。”
王硕恨不得再找个机会跟刘济民煮酒论英雄，说一句：“青年作家唯君与硕尔！”
两人熟络之后，王硕更是要跟刘济民以兄弟相称，一口一个“济哥”。
等王硕走后，杨波冲着王硕的背影摇了摇头：“丫真是大院子弟，估计之前没少跟人茬架。大院的老兵都横，你们没在燕京，68年的时候他们跟顽主茬架，几乎遇见就打。
后来出了一个叫小混蛋的顽主，那是敢动刀子的家伙，不过啊，被一群老兵围着叉了。本来是要送到医院急救的，谁知道左一刀、右一刀的就弄死了。”
杨波讲的绘声绘色，顿时吸引了全宿舍的注意。讲完之后，梁满囤等人还不忘询问一下中央工作会议的最新动静。
大会的动静没来，但是针对刘济民的动静倒是来了。

Chapter 49 The dispute between “old and new” - "Literary Hero 1978: Starting as a Military Writer"

Before the Third Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, a 36-day central working conference was held.
These days, even the residents of the courtyard, who are trapped in scraps and scraps, talk about "policies" and talk about "gossip". They didn't eat in the house on a cold day, but gathered in the courtyard to chat about the news they knew.
The entire Ju'er Hutong has achieved unprecedented harmony. The so-called neighborhood conflicts have disappeared, and Comrade Wang Aimei's workload has been greatly reduced.
After all, we can sit down and talk about major national issues and differences, not to mention the trivial matters in the courtyard. Is there anything that can't be solved by talking?
Comrade Liu Zhenguo did not dare to buy a house easily for fear of policy changes. If something changes, the money earned will probably be wasted in the end.
In the Academy of Medical Sciences, students gather together in small groups every day to discuss national affairs, wishing they could use the chalk in their hands as a baton.
In particular, the students in the literary club are the most active. As cultural people, their interest in talking about current affairs is just like it is in their genes.
Due to Liu Jimin's status in the literary circle of Yanjing universities, college students around him who like literature are willing to come to the Academy of Medical Sciences for exchanges. Many people went to Liu Jimin's dormitory to discuss policy trends with him.
When Wang Shuo had nothing to do, he ran to the Academy of Medical Sciences and told Liu Jimin some gossip. For example, a certain writer went to "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" to demand that Liu Jimin's "Top Gun" be suppressed, or to delete the emotional scenes between men and women.
Wang Shuo angrily told Liu Jimin that these old stubborns should be swept into the garbage dump and the world of literature should be given to young people.
"The love poems you wrote were also scolded. They were almost called pornographic poems." Wang Shuo put his arm around Liu Jimin's shoulders and consoled him: "
Don’t worry, with the support of Mr. Liu, the editorial department can still withstand the firepower. In fact, it's not just a literary debate at this time. After all, there is a conference, so the venue is lively! "
"Comrade Jimin, let me just take a look at your temper. You are one of the young writers in the army now, and I am also one. It's just that I am hiding in the abyss, and my reputation is not obvious. I have only published one poem."
Wang Shuo couldn't wait to find another opportunity to have a drink with Liu Jimin and talk about heroes, and said: "Young writers are the only ones with Shuoer!"
After the two got acquainted with each other, Wang Shuo and Liu Jimin became more and more like brothers, and they were called "Brother Ji".
After Wang Shuo left, Yang Bo shook his head at Wang Shuo's back: "You are really a brother from the courtyard. I guess you have quarreled with others before. The veterans in the courtyard are all arrogant. You were not in Yanjing. In 1968, they quarreled with the stubborn masters and almost fought when they met.
Later, a stubborn guy named Little Bastard appeared. He was a guy who dared to use a knife, but he was surrounded by a group of veterans and stabbed him. He was originally going to be sent to the hospital for emergency treatment, but who knew that he was killed by a knife on the left and a knife on the right. "
Yang Bo spoke vividly and immediately attracted the attention of the whole dormitory. After finishing speaking, Liang Mandun and others did not forget to ask about the latest developments at the Central Work Conference.
No news about the conference came, but news about Liu Jimin did.
